description: This is a Java service class named PublisherService within a book management application. It provides methods to find, save, delete, and count Publisher entities, functioning as part of the business logic layer.

classes.name: PublisherService
classes.description: A service class that manages Publisher entities, providing CRUD operations and leveraging a PublisherRepository for persistence.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Publisher by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Publisher entity if it has a non-empty name.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all Publisher entities.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Publisher entities.
